name: 候補件数を示す複合クイックフィルター
prompt:
Recreate only the monday.com Quick filters panel shown in the primary original crop. Match the original 1070x580 crop and layout closely. Use the original source’s neutral colors and restrained typography. No Japanese mock exists. Keep the rounded white panel, header and footer dividers, broad whitespace above the filter chips and source column positions. Exclude the background table.

Important color and weight corrections: use dark gray or black text for 「クイックフィルター」, all four column headings, 「すべてクリア」, the outlined save button label, and the footer action 「詳細フィルターに切り替え」. The source uses a thin light-gray outline and dark text for 「新しいビューとして保存」; do not color these actions blue. Keep the title and column headings regular/medium weight like the source, not heavy bold. Preserve colors only on the status dots and person avatars: JD yellow, JS violet-purple, unassigned outline gray; status dots green/yellow, orange, red, green and light blue.

Header, left to right: 「クイックフィルター」, muted 「3件中3件のタスクを表示」, small circled question-mark help icon. At the far right show 「すべてクリア」 and the neutral outlined 「新しいビューとして保存」 button.

In the body, show the full columns headed 「担当者」, 「ステータス」, 「日付」, 「週数」. Preserve source row positions and counts. Person: JD avatar + truncated 「自分（dynam…」 count 1; JD avatar + Jane Doe count 1; violet JS avatar + John Smith count 1; outline avatar + 「未割り当て」 count 1. Status with colored dots and count 1: 「すべて完了ラベル」 (green/yellow), 「作業中」 (orange), 「停滞中」 (red), 「完了」 (green), 「レビュー準備中…」 (light blue). Date rows with a right dash: 「期限超過」, 「期限内に完了」, 「期限超過で完了」, 「今日」, 「明日」. Weeks: 「3」 count 1, 「0.5」 count 1, 「1」 count 1, 「空白」 without count.

At the extreme left keep the narrow clipped sliver of the previous filter column and its three partial chips with visible 1 counts. Add only a simple dark-gray left chevron over that area; no filled circular button. Do not complete the hidden chip labels. Keep chips pale gray with rounded corners. At the bottom, retain the divider and left-aligned dark-gray footer action. Do not add extra rows, filters or table content.
reviewNotes: LH09-0261 v002 compared with the exact source crop. It improves the action colors, button border, text weight and chevron style. Remaining visible defects: the first status option omits the source yellow dot, the clipped left chips lose their visible text fragments, and an extra vertical divider appears beside that clipped column. Candidate remains a close structural match but these source details are not reproduced. Status: needs-correction after two attempts; image-generation review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
